title: Balanced Binary Tree
inputFormat: Implement isBalanced(root). The runner converts the level-order array into nodes with val, left, and right fields; [] becomes null.
outputFormat: true if every node’s left and right subtree heights differ by at most one; otherwise false. An empty tree is balanced.

visuals.title: Balanced does not mean identical
